summary.name: Gaphor
summary.one_liner: Gaphor is an open-source, Python-based modeling application for UML, SysML, RAAML, and C4 diagrams.
use_cases: documenting a software project with UML diagrams
creating class, interaction, or state machine diagrams
requirements and block definition modeling for systems
summary.what_it_does: ["Provides a UML, SysML, RAAML, and C4 modeling application built on a fully-compliant UML 2 data model, so diagrams are backed by a real model rather than just drawings.", "Supports Class, Interaction, State Machine, Block Definition, and Requirements diagrams, and allows different diagram items to be mixed on one diagram.", "Includes a built-in styling engine to customize diagrams and a tree view to find all model elements.", "Can be extended with plug-in code generators or custom extensions accessible via the GUI or CLI; diagrams can be exported for documentation."]
notable: Written in Python and 100% open source under the Apache 2 license
Implements OMG UML, SysML, and RAAML standards plus C4 model support
Stereotypes and other information are shown in diagrams; no hidden property panels
caveats: The page does not describe any paid tiers or limitations.
